title: Pastel Celestial Clipart Bundle, Watercolor Moon and Stars PNG, Dreamy Galaxy Graphics, Commercial Use
description_html:
Pastel Celestial Clipart Bundle

Bring a touch of dreamy magic to your creative projects with this beautiful Pastel Celestial Clipart Bundle! This high-quality set includes 12 transparent PNG clipart elements featuring soft watercolor moons, twinkling stars, celestial suns, and fluffy pastel clouds. Designed in a gorgeous palette of lavender, blush pink, baby blue, and mint with faux gold accents, these graphics are perfect for bringing your ideas to life.

Each file is saved as a high-resolution 300 DPI transparent PNG, ensuring crisp and vibrant printing every time. Whether you are creating digital planners, baby shower invitations, custom stickers, scrapbooking pages, or print-on-demand merchandise, this versatile moon and stars bundle has exactly what you need.

Enjoy the convenience of an instant download so you can start crafting immediately! This bundle is commercial-use-friendly, making it an excellent addition to your small business design toolkit. Add a starry, magical vibe to your shop or personal crafts with these dreamy celestial graphics today!
